EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest Social Technologies program at ASU!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for expressing interest in the master of Arts in Social Technologies program at Arizona State University. The master's in social technologies is a groundbreaking program for students who wish to understand how new technologies relate to social and organizational change and to apply that understanding to help organizations and communities advance their interests. Focused on the increasing prominence of social technologies in nearly every facet of contemporary life, the MAST is an interdisciplinary degree anchored in social, behavioral, cultural and design approaches to this new reality. For more information about the program feel free to review the MAST Program Handbook. https://newcollege.asu.edu/sites/default/files/files/advising/documents/mast_graduate_handbook_2015-16.pdf
Be sure to review our application checklist at this address: https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B44BICxe1BtdakFBQkZMeFlFMTA/view for more information about the application process in an easy to follow format, and peruse our sample schedule here: http://links.asu.edu/kbuqx to explore the flexible curriculum available for both full-time and part-time students. Also, please take a moment to check out our new e-magazine on our site and see all the exciting work being done by our faculty and students.
It's important to find the right fit in graduate school. A great way to learn more about this degree is to register for one of our upcoming information sessions. You can view the dates on our site, then email me to RSVP for any date you plan to attend.
Kindest regards, Graduate Studies
New College of Interdisciplinary Arts and Sciences Arizona State University, West campus nc.gradstudies@asu.edu
